testcase.name: volume-plugin/awsElasticBlockStore
testcase.system-out: warning: In-tree volume plugin awsElasticBlockStore needs CSI driver ebs.csi.aws.com from 1.27 (1 object). 1 object names it, in: shop (1). From 1.27 the ebs.csi.aws.com CSI driver serves every operation on these volumes: a cluster without it installed cannot mount them, one with it is fine. Objects: - shop/web (f.yaml:1) Fix: install the ebs.csi.aws.com CSI driver (aws-ebs-csi-driver) before the upgrade. References: - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.27.md - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/115838
